comment: The currency the storefront displays prices in by default.
modal: The base display currency shown to shoppers. It must be one of the **Allowed Currencies**. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The currencies shoppers can switch between on the storefront.
modal: The set of currencies made available on the storefront; the **Default Display Currency** must be one of them. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: How many seconds to wait for the legacy Fixer.io rate service before timing out.
modal: The connection timeout, in seconds, for currency rate requests to the legacy **Fixer.io** service.

comment: The API key used to authenticate with the Fixer (APILayer) exchange-rate service.
modal: The credential for the **Fixer API (APILayer)** currency rate provider. Stored encrypted.

comment: How many seconds to wait for the Fixer (APILayer) rate service before timing out.
modal: The connection timeout, in seconds, for currency rate requests to the **Fixer API (APILayer)** service.

comment: The API key used to authenticate with the Currency Converter API service.
modal: The credential for the **Currency Converter API** rate provider. Stored encrypted.

comment: How many seconds to wait for the Currency Converter API service before timing out.
modal: The connection timeout, in seconds, for currency rate requests to the **Currency Converter API** service.

comment: Whether exchange rates are imported automatically on a schedule.
modal: When **Yes**, currency rates are fetched automatically from the configured service on the chosen frequency. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The email address notified when a scheduled currency rate import fails.
modal: The recipient for failure notifications from the scheduled rate import. Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Which store email identity sends the scheduled-import failure notification.
modal: Selects the sender identity for rate-import failure emails — one of the **Store Email Addresses** identities (General Contact, Sales Representative, Customer Support, Custom 1/2). Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website.

comment: How often the scheduled currency rate import runs.
modal: The cron frequency for the automatic rate import: **Daily**, **Weekly**, or **Monthly**. Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Which exchange-rate provider the scheduled import pulls rates from.
modal: Selects the rate service used by the scheduled import (the configured currency import providers). Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The time of day the scheduled currency rate import runs.
modal: The start time (hour, minute, second) for the automatic rate import. Applies only when scheduled import is **Enabled**. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The full set of currencies available for use as allowed or display currencies.
modal: The currencies installed for the store, forming the pool from which **Allowed Currencies** and the **Default Display Currency** are chosen.

comment: The countries for which the ZIP/postal code field is not required in addresses.
modal: Addresses for the selected countries can be saved without a ZIP/postal code; for all others it stays mandatory.

comment: The countries for which a state/province must be provided in addresses.
modal: Addresses for the selected countries require a state/province to be chosen or entered.

comment: Whether the state/province field is shown even for countries where it is optional.
modal: When **Yes**, the state/province selector appears for countries where state is optional, letting customers supply it anyway.

comment: The unit of measure used for product weights.
modal: The weight unit applied to products: **lbs** or **kgs**. Can differ per website or store view.
